title: Odd reciprocal binomial expectation bounds
statement: For every natural number $m$, let $J$ have the binomial distribution with $m$ trials and success probability $1/2$. Then $\displaystyle\frac{1-2^{-(m+1)}}{m+1}\le \mathbb E\!\left[\frac{1}{2J+1}\right]\le\frac{1-2^{-(m+1)}}{m+1}+\frac{4}{(m+1)(m+2)}$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ has the binomial distribution with $m$ trials and success probability $1/2$
